question: Will another merchant vessel be attacked in the Black Sea off Bulgaria or Romania on October 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: During the Oct 5-19 2026 campaign, merchant ships off BG/RO were hit on about 5 of 15 days (~33%/day), in two clusters (Oct 5-6, Oct 12/13-15). No ship hits were reported Oct 16-19 (a 4-day lull), though Geran drones were still flown toward the Sulina anchorage and shot down by Romanian F-16s on Oct 17-18. Attempts continue and Russia reportedly rejected the moratorium, which argues against going much lower. Active interception, the NATO posture change, shipping avoiding the anchorage, autumn weather and the gaps between clusters argue for a per-day rate well below the active-phase 33% for one specific UTC day 9 days out. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agreed on the main facts: about 5 strike-days out of 15 between Oct 5 and Oct 19, no ship hits Oct 16-19, and Geran drones shot down near Sulina Oct 17-18. One factual dispute is the dating of Chelsea 3 / HS Dignity (Oct 12-13 vs 13-14), with some wire reports dating Wine Trader to Oct 16-17. That cannot be settled without web access, and it moves the per-day rate by only about one day in fifteen. Run 3 reports that Russia rejected the moratorium; the other runs only say no moratorium had been agreed. These are consistent, and both mean no diplomatic stop is in place. The remaining spread (0.14-0.17) is pure judgment about how fast the cluster decays versus whether attempts persist. I take about 0.15: attempts continue, but interception and posture changes are reducing hit rates, and the question names a single day.
